facts_found: A cash back / rewards discrepancy is handled by a dedicated 'cash back dispute' process that applies to all credit card transactions when the customer believes the cash back received differs from the cash back that should have been received. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]

The dispute is initiated by the customer running the tool submit_cash_back_dispute_0589 with their own user_id and the specific transaction_id; the agent confirms the correct transaction_id, does not collect sensitive card details, and advises that supporting context (category or promotion expectations) may be requested later during review. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]

Corrections are applied only AFTER a cash back dispute is resolved and approved; the agent must then update the affected transaction(s) with the correct rewards value. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Correction step 1: identify transactions requiring correction by looking up the user's resolved disputes in the cash_back_disputes database to find the transaction_id values needing rewards adjustments. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]
Correction step 2: use unlock_discoverable_agent_tool to unlock the agent tool update_transaction_rewards_3847. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Correction step 3: independently recalculate correct rewards for each transaction based on card type, transaction category, and any applicable promotions; do not rely on the expected_rewards field in the dispute record. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Correction step 4: invoke update_transaction_rewards_3847 via call_discoverable_agent_tool with transaction_id and new_rewards_earned formatted as 'X points' where X is the correct whole-number point value; the tool sets the transaction's rewards to the corrected value (so it can raise or lower awards). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Post-correction compliance: ensure the calculation reflects the proper base rate and any active bonus category or promotion at the time of purchase, confirm the update in credit_card_transaction_history, and retain calculation notes in the internal case record for auditability. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Customer-facing triggers for a rewards review include: a bonus-category purchase that earned only the standard rate, a purchase that earned less than the calculated rate, no rewards on a qualifying purchase, and suspected merchant miscategorization; support verifies merchant category and applicable rates and applies the correct amount if the customer was shortchanged. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_021]

Customers should supply transaction date, merchant name and purchase amount, received vs expected cash back, and receipts/documentation to support a rewards investigation. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_021]

Dispute history/status can be reviewed with get_user_dispute_history_7291(user_id), which returns dispute_id, dispute_date, status (e.g., open, under_review, closed), transaction_id, reason_code, outcome and notes. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

For the Silver Rewards Card, if a purchase is misclassified the customer may be asked to provide receipts/invoices during a rewards review; rewards are visible as pending after posting and final amounts may adjust if the merchant updates the transaction or issues a credit. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]

New Business Silver Rewards Card customers can earn 2x cash back on all purchases for the first 6 months after account opening (travel/software 10.0% multiplied by 2; other 1.0% multiplied by 2); the offer window is 2024-11-14 through 2025-11-14 and the account must have been opened during that period; merchant category exclusions still apply. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

The 6-month 2x window for the Business Silver promo begins on the account opening date, not the promotional start date, and the increased rate is applied automatically with no separate enrollment. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

Provisional credit rules apply to credit card transaction disputes (unauthorized/duplicate/not-received), not to rewards/cash back discrepancies; rewards disputes are not a provisional-credit category. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_015]

No documented investigation/resolution timeline (SLA) specific to cash back disputes; the only timelines found relate to transaction disputes and provisional credit.

No explicit policy statement on whether over-awarded points that the customer has already redeemed may be reversed/clawed back; the correction tool resets the transaction's rewards to the correct value, but downstream balance recovery is not documented.
No documented promotion or other explanation for a personal Silver Rewards Card software purchase earning 10% instead of 4.0% (only the Business Silver 2x promo is documented).
No documented rule on whether a rewards dispute must be filed per transaction or can cover multiple transactions in one submission.
